categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Sidike New Materials Science & Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the research, development, production, and sales of functional coated composite materials including functional film materials, electronic-grade adhesives, thermal management composite materials, film packaging materials, and polymer film materials. These products serve key industries such as consumer electronics, new energy vehicles, microelectronics, and commercial packaging.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as precision coating, printing, vacuum sputtering, and sintering to combine various coating materials with different film substrates (e.g., PET, PI, PVC) to create functional composite materials. It has developed proprietary polymer synthesis, coating formula optimization, functional structure design, and precision coating manufacturing capabilities, supported by imported advanced production lines from Japan and Germany, and operates high-standard cleanroom environments with real-time defect monitoring.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic and international terminal manufacturers in consumer electronics (smartphones, tablets, laptops, wearable devices), automotive electronics (especially new energy vehicles), electronic components (PCB, MLCC), and new energy sectors. The company maintains close embedded R&D collaborations with these end customers to tailor products to their specific performance requirements.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with major facilities in Jiangsu Province (Sihong, Taicang) and subsidiaries in the United States, Japan, South Korea, Hong Kong, Taiwan, and Vietnam. Its sales are predominantly in mainland China (over 90% of revenue), with a smaller portion in overseas markets including Hong Kong, Taiwan, and other international regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sidike is positioned upstream in the functional coated composite materials supply chain, focusing on the development and production of core materials such as functional films and electronic-grade adhesives. The company has expanded upstream to self-produce key raw materials like adhesives, PET base films, and release films, enhancing vertical integration and supply chain control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment (over 8% of sales in 2024) focusing on flexible optical displays, new energy vehicle electronics, optical PET base materials, MLCC release films, and adhesives. It pursues innovation through an embedded R&D model closely aligned with end customers, aiming to break foreign technology monopolies, develop high-value-added products like OCA optical adhesives, and expand upstream raw material self-sufficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of functional coated composite materials and electronic-grade adhesives to downstream customers, mainly via direct sales contracts and supplemented by authorized distributors. The company recognizes revenue at the point of control transfer, typically upon delivery and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with global leaders such as 3M, Tesa, Mitsubishi Chemical, Nitto Denko, and Lindeco, especially in high-end optical adhesives and functional films. Sidike is recognized as a leading domestic player with growing technological capabilities and market share, actively pursuing import substitution and aiming to establish itself as a top-tier international supplier.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Sidike reported revenues of approximately RMB 2.69 billion, a 36.68% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 54.88 million, slightly down by 2.11%. The company has shown rapid growth in sales volume and production capacity, especially in electronic-grade adhesives and polymer films, supported by ongoing capacity expansions and vertical integration. Despite profit pressure from increased depreciation, finance costs, and R&D expenses, the company maintains a stable growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sidike offers high-performance, precision-engineered functional coated composite materials that enable enhanced product features such as lightness, thinness, multifunctionality, and improved user experience in consumer electronics and new energy vehicles. Its embedded R&D approach ensures close alignment with customer needs, enabling rapid innovation and customization. Vertical integration of raw materials and advanced manufacturing technologies provide quality assurance, cost control, and competitive advantages in breaking foreign technology monopolies.
